rca of the issue: Frontend duplicate-key warning RCA: OperationsRoom.jsx posts a message → setMessages([...prev, newMsg]) → 3.5s later, GET /api/alliances/{aid}/messages?since=<last_ts> returns the same just-sent message (since the server-side 'since' filter uses '$gt' but client's last_ts is the timestamp BEFORE the new send), and the merge appends it again with the same id. Fix: in the poll merge, do `const ids = new Set(prev.map(m=>m.id)); return [...prev, ...incoming.filter(m=>!ids.has(m.id))]`.
